answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 6651 Country: India Title: According to Vaastu Shastra & Fengsui, if you sleep under the beam of your house, you will fall seriously sick and become terminally ill.What has Islam got to say under its shariat law? Question: According to Vaastu Shastra & Fengsui, if you sleep under the beam of your house, you will fall seriously sick and become terminally ill.What has Islam got to say under its shariat law? Answer ID: 6651 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 960/883=L/1429) It has no base in Islam, the Hadith says: لا عدوی و لاطیرۃ (there is no evil omen no superstition). However, one should avoid sleeping under the beam, since if he gets sick by the order of Allah, he will fall in superstition. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
